posts.author: Z-Rune
posts.body:
Hello all. Longtime listener, first time caller so apologies for any dumb remarks, redundant questions or rule violations I may make in advance.
I'm wanting to create enemy categories or types for both weakness/resistance purposes as well as an in-game bestiary. Would someone be able to point me in the right direction for getting that going? Thanks in advance!

posts.author: ATT_Turan
posts.body:
Welcome!
I Googled "rpg maker mz bestiary plugin" and there are several options that come up:
[CGMZ] Encyclopedia and Bestiary
[CGMZ] Encyclopedia and Bestiary By: Casper Gaming Last Update: August 21, 2024 Latest Version: 1.12.0  This plugin creates a powerful encyclopedia for your game, with default categories including bestiary, items, armors, weapons, skills, states, and actors. It can also handle as many custom...
forums.rpgmakerweb.com
Bestiary VisuStella MZ - Yanfly.moe Wiki
www.yanfly.moe
As far as displaying some kind of type, you'd have to see what's supported by the specific plugin. If neither of them have that, Casper's would be easier to use because you could get help editing the code - VisuStella's is obfuscated, so you're limited to what options they provide.

posts.author: CasperGaming
posts.body: [CGMZ] Encyclopedia and Bestiary can handle displaying any custom flavor text you want. To do so, you would add your type to the enemy via the Extra Bestiary Settings -> Custom Info parameter and then display it in the bestiary by adding a Custom Info line to the Bestiary Display Info parameter. You can drag+drop the lines in your Bestiary Display Info parameter to change the order info displays in the window.
